title: `os dev` on an `os init -t app` scaffold warns "Plugin superseded: 'com.objectstack.metadata'" on every boot, because the platform registers its own metadata plugin twice
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYMkB4dbaYNKufhvBr

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with a named landing point. Reach: the boot banner of `npx objectstack dev` on the CLI's own `init -t app` scaffold, measured on every boot (2 of 2).
Business reason: docs.objectos.ai's "Run ObjectOS Community locally" Path B is `npx @objectstack/cli init my-app -t app --install` then the dev server. On a scaffold the user has not touched, the boot diagnostics print `WARN Plugin superseded: 'com.objectstack.metadata' — the later registration (v1.0.0) REPLACED the earlier one … register the plugin once if that is not what you meant.` The user registered no plugin: the config has no `plugins` key. A first boot that tells a newcomer they misconfigured something they never wrote teaches them to ignore boot diagnostics, which is where real problems are reported. The `npm create objectstack` template (which declares three connector plugins) does not print it, so the two official on-ramps disagree.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:cli` implementer in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`: the dev artifact door (`devArtifactDoor = new MetadataPlugin(...)`, about L3601) is added on the branch where `createStandaloneStack` (`packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts` about L1068) already composed a `MetadataPlugin`. The host-config door at L3647 already checks for an existing one; the dev door does not.
Duplicate search (incl. closed): `"Plugin superseded"` → 20 hits (top 6 read: #19387, #9863, #25747, #16140, #21102, #22934, none about the metadata plugin on a scaffold), `superseded metadata plugin os init` → 73 (top 6 read, unrelated).

QA-source: post-release 18.3.0 newcomer walkthrough, docs.objectos.ai Community Path B, anchor #27377

## Reproduction (published @objectstack/cli 18.3.0, Node 22.23.4, npm only, empty `HOME`)
1. `npx -y @objectstack/cli init my-app -t app --install && cd my-app` (the scaffold validates: "63 author-time rules passed").
2. `npx objectstack dev`.

Observed: "Boot diagnostics — 1 informational: … WARN Plugin superseded: 'com.objectstack.metadata' — the later registration (v1.0.0) REPLACED the earlier one (v1.0.0) …". It repeats on the rebuild after adding an object.

Expected: a clean scaffold boots with no diagnostic that blames the user's composition.
